source.authors: Grassby-Lewis RJ, Brakels P, Maury N, Sitthivong S, Frohlich D, Pawangkhanant P, Idiiatullina SS, Nguyen TV, Poyarkov NA
source.title: A new endemic karst-associated species of lance-headed pit viper (Squamata, Viperidae, Protobothrops) from Laos

method: taxonomic description of the preserved holotype; Material and methods > Morphological examination: 'We used a Mitutoyo digital caliper to take the following measurements to the nearest 0.1 mm:' with 'ED, horizontal eye diameter;' (reader tooltip expansion removed), EN defined as eye to nostril (distance between anterior margin of eye and posterior margin of nostril) and NL as nostril-loreal pit distance; the holotype description prints NL 3.0 mm and EN 5.7 mm (not filed here). No loreal-pit size or nostril size is defined or measured; this record files the qualitative description only
conditions: One individual: holotype as printed 'NUOL (National University of Laos) R.2024.89, adult female', from the environs of the Khan Kham Cave, Vang Vieng District, Vientiane Province, Laos (360 m a.s.l.), collected 21 October 2024. Fixation as printed: 'The specimen was fixed in 4% buffered formalin for 24 h and later stored in 70% ethanol.' No paratype is printed; the Variation section states only a single specimen was collected and rests on two iNaturalist photo records, and does not mention the loreal pit or nostril. The Diagnosis does not mention the loreal pit or nostril; the Introduction prints 'The genus Protobothrops is morphologically characterised by the presence of a well-developed loreal pit;' as a genus character. Same description prints 'Pupil vertically elliptical.' and an eye sentence with ED 3.5 mm, EN 5.7 mm and ED/EN ratio 0.61 (not filed here). Anatomy only; no function tested.
measurement: loreal pit presence, size, shape and position relative to eye and nostril in the holotype description
value: present, large, triangular, located closer to eye than to nostril
where: Systematics > Family Viperidae Oppel, 1811 > Subfamily Crotalinae Oppel, 1811 > Genus Protobothrops Hoge & Romano-Hoge, 1983 > Protobothrops flavirostris sp. nov. > Description of the holotype.
quote: Loreal pit present, large, triangular in shape, located closer to eye than to nostril (Fig. 3C, D).
note: Search that reached the page: 'A new endemic karst-associated species of lance-headed pit viper (Squamata, Viperidae, Protobothrops) from Laos Herpetozoa' (first result, herpetozoa.pensoft.net article_preview.php?id=146004). Name: Reptile Database page Protobothrops flavirostris Grassby-Lewis, Brakels, Maury, Sitthivong, Frohlich, Pawangkhanant, Idiiatullina, Nguyen & Poyarkov, 2025 opened from a search result (Higher Taxa Viperidae, Crotalinae; holotype NUOL R.2024.89, adult female; synonym list holds only the original name; source Herpetozoa 38: 43-60). The paper prints Family, Subfamily and Genus heading lines with authorities under Systematics and no Class or Order heading. Not on main: grep of docs/ for the species and for herpetozoa.38.e146004 under any trait finds only progress notes (desk-d499, d508, d572); no evidence row. Page-printed licence sentence on the exact copy (article_preview), read in pieces: 'This is an open access article distributed under the terms of the Creative Commons Attribution License (CC BY 4.0), which permits unrestricted use, distribution, and reproduction in any medium, provided the original author and source are credited.' Quote reassembled from consecutive reader pieces and rechecked on article_preview by audit 1132. Crossref not used.

source.authors: Chen H-L, Yu J-Y, Li Y-B, Li Y-H, Chen Z-N
source.title: A new species of Goniurosaurus (Sauria, Gekkota, Eublepharidae) from Guangxi, China

measurement: tympanum condition and bordering scales in the holotype description
value: deeply recessed; bordered anteriorly by two spinose scales
method: taxonomic description of the preserved holotype; Materials and methods > Morphology: measurements followed Ziegler et al. (2008) with a vernier caliper (DL3945, 0–200 mm range, 0.03 mm accuracy); eye–ear distance (EE) is defined from posterior margin of eye to posterior margin of ear and printed for the holotype as 9.2 mm (not filed); no tympanum or ear-opening size is defined or measured
conditions: One individual: holotype GXNU2025101603, adult male, Baishou Nature Reserve, Yongfu County, Guilin City, Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region, China (323 m a.s.l.), collected 26 October 2025. Preservation as printed: 'All specimens were fixed and preserved in 75% ethanol, and partial muscle tissues were sampled and stored at –80 °C in an ultra-low-temperature freezer for subsequent molecular analyses.' Paratypes as printed: 'Three adult females GXNU2025090812 (Fig. 2B), GXNU2025101601 (Fig. 2C) – 02 (Fig. 2D), same data to the holotype.' The Diagnosis, Comparisons and Variation sections do not mention the tympanum or ear, so no paratype value exists. This is the only sentence on the tympanum in the paper. Anatomy only; hearing not tested.
where: Results > Systematics > Goniurosaurus wuzhengjuni Chen & Chen, sp. nov. > Description (holotype paragraph, which opens 'Holotype. GXNU2025101603, adult male')
quote: The tympanum is deeply recessed and bordered anteriorly by two spinose scales.
note: Search that reached the page: 'A new species of Goniurosaurus (Sauria, Gekkota, Eublepharidae) from Guangxi, China Zoosystematics and Evolution' (result zse.pensoft.net/article_preview.php?id=177343). Name: Reptile Database page Goniurosaurus wuzhengjuni Chen, Yu, Li, Li & Chen, 2026 opened from a search result (Higher Taxa Eublepharidae, Gekkota, Sauria, Squamata; holotype GXNU 2025101603, adult male; synonym list holds only the original name; source Zoosystematics and Evolution 102(2): 611-620). The paper's account heading prints the authority as 'Chen & Chen'; no Class, Order, Family or Genus heading is printed under Systematics. Same species and DOI are on main only as one pupil_shape row (desk-d573, 'The eyes are relatively large with vertical pupils.'), a different trait and finding; no sensory_anatomy row. Page-printed licence sentence on the exact copy, read in pieces: 'This is an open access article distributed under the terms of the Creative Commons Attribution License (CC BY 4.0), which permits unrestricted use, distribution, and reproduction in any medium, provided the original author and source are credited.' Quote rechecked on article_preview by audit 1132. Crossref not used. The Description also prints a naris sentence that is not filed.

source.authors: Poyarkov NA, Skorinova DD, Bragin AM, Kolchanov VV, Gorin VA, Trofimets AV, Yuzefovich AP, Le DX, Nguyen TV, Skutschas PP
source.title: Integrative taxonomy reveals a new unstriped Ichthyophis Fitzinger, 1826 from Vietnam and provides new data on diagnostic osteological traits for Asian tailed caecilians (Gymnophiona: Ichthyophiidae)

method: micro-CT skull atlas of the holotype (SkyScan 1272); osteological description in the Results
conditions: One individual: the holotype ZMMU A-8208, adult female, 206 mm total length, per the Figure 2 caption ('General skull morphology of the holotype of Ichthyophis griseivermis sp. nov.'), Xuan Lien National Park, Thanh Hoa Province, Vietnam; the Results sentence opening the osteology description names 'the female specimen ZMMU A-8208' from Xuan Lien NP. Type series as the page shows it: Table 1 column headers give ZMMU A-8208 (status H, sex F) and VRTC NAP-08953 (status P, sex M), one paratype; the Micro-computed tomography paragraph prints the second specimen as 'VRTC NAP08953' (no hyphen) and says both were X-rayed but only 'the better-preserved specimen' ZMMU A-8208 had detailed micro-CT of the cranium and atlas (SkyScan 1272). The Holotype and Paratype entries of the species account were not reached by the page reader, so codes and sexes come from Table 1 and the figure caption. Preservation as printed (Material and Methods > Sampling, whole sentence): 'A living specimen was photographed and subsequently euthanized by a 20% benzocaine solution; tissue samples (liver) were taken for genetic analyses and stored in 96% ethanol prior to specimen fixation in a 4% formaldehyde solution for 24 h with subsequent preservation in 70% ethanol.' The Results section heading names the specimen 'Ichthyophis sp.'; its tie to I. griseivermis rests on the Figure 2 caption and Table 1. Skeletal (bony) anatomy from CT, not soft-tissue anatomy. Anatomy only; function not tested.
where: Results > Skull atlas of an Ichthyophis sp. from northern Vietnam > Osteology description > General features of the skull (bold run-in label, not a heading); paragraph opening 'The cranium bears the following ten major external openings'. No Class, Order or Family heading is printed anywhere in the paper (Gymnophiona and Ichthyophiidae appear only in the title).
note: Search that reached the page: 'new species Ichthyophis OR Chikila OR Uraeotyphlus OR Siphonops OR Caecilia sp. nov. 2025 2026 tentacle eyes visible through skin novataxa' (result vertebrate-zoology.arphahub.com/article_preview.php?id=149399). Name: Amphibian Species of the World page Ichthyophis griseivermis Poyarkov, Skorinova, Bragin, Kolchanov, Gorin, Trofimets, Yuzefovich, Le, Nguyen and Skutschas, 2025 opened from my own search result (holotype ZMMU A-8208, no synonymy listed; the page text names no family, the URL path gives Ichthyophiidae and the paper's title prints Ichthyophiidae). Not on main: grep of docs/ for griseivermis and vz.75.e149399 finds only progress notes (desk-d298, d304, d308, d514) recording no eye or ED statement; no evidence row. The reader text for this page covered the first 100000 of 122970 characters plus a read from offset 100000 (table rows only); the species description, diagnosis and variation sections were not returned by the reader, so no description sentence on the tentacular aperture is cited. Page-printed licence sentence read in three pieces on the exact copy: 'This is an open access article distributed under the terms of the Creative Commons Attribution License (CC BY 4.0), which permits unrestricted use, distribution, and reproduction in any medium, provided the original author and source are credited.' Crossref not used. Audit 1133 (article_preview page, Pensoft XML and ASW page, all opened from my own WebSearch results): quote rechecked on the article_preview page in the paragraph opening 'The cranium bears the following ten major external openings'; heading path completed (run-in label; no Class, Order or Family heading printed); paratype from Table 1 added; preservation now the whole Sampling sentence (the original began mid-sentence at 'prior to'). Citation line on the page: 'Poyarkov NA, Skorinova DD, Bragin AM, Kolchanov VV, Gorin VA, Trofimets AV, Yuzefovich AP, Le DX, Nguyen TV, Skutschas PP (2025) ... Vertebrate Zoology 75: 405-440. https://doi.org/10.3897/vz.75.e149399' (no issue printed); title verbatim per the XML article-title; licence sentence identical on the page and in the XML license-p. ASW prints 'Ichthyophis griseivermis Poyarkov, Skorinova, Bragin, Kolchanov, Gorin, Trofimets, Yuzefovich, Le, Nguyen, and Skutschas, 2025', 'Vert. Zool., Senckenberg, 75: 422', 'Holotype: ZMMU A-8208, by original designation.', no synonymy; family from the URL path Amphibia/Gymnophiona/Ichthyophiidae. Methods eye passage (Material and Methods > External morphology, cut): 'We used a Mitutoyo (Kanagawa, Japan) digital caliper to take the following measurements to the nearest 0.1 mm: … eye diameter, the widest diameter of the visible part of the eye (ED); …' (an eye-diameter definition is printed, unit mm; it concerns the external eye, not this skull record, which carries no eye diameter). Trait fit: the bony housing of a named sense organ described from CT; kept under sensory_anatomy as anatomical_presence, as main files bony sensory elements (stapes footplate, desk-d338) and reptile orbit diameters; the structure string is free text under an existing trait, so no 'new trait' note is needed. Distinct from line 5 (orbital aperture): different structure and sentence. Repeat check: grep of the whole docs/ tree for griseivermis and vz.75.e149399 finds only progress notes (desk-d298, d304, d308, d514, d579), no evidence row under any trait.
measurement: position and openness of the tentacular canal in the holotype skull
value: open laterally, fused with the orbital aperture, lies entirely in the maxillopalatine
quote: The tentacular canal is open laterally, fused with the orbital aperture, and lies entirely in the maxillopalatine.
